dependency_direction: This run record binds the input, exposure, and exact reconstruction text hash. It does not reference the subsequently constructed reconstruction JSON hash.

exposure.knowledge_scope: This records observed artifact exposure during this decoder run. It does not assert absence of general pretrained mathematical knowledge or absence of ambient runtime instructions.
other_visible_context: system and developer runtime and tool instructions
parent decoder task including the permitted path and expected hashes

freeze_order: This record is written at its content-addressed path and made read-only before its hash is bound in the final reconstruction.

input.packet_hash_provenance: Read from packet_sha256 in the allowed input; also present in task instructions. Canonical packet hashing was not independently recomputed.
input.raw_hash_verification: SHA-256 computed from the exact bytes read from the allowed input file; it matched the parent-supplied expected value.

text_hash_encoding: UTF-8 bytes of reconstructed_theorem_text, with no additional terminal newline
